verdict.rationale: Justworks is an HR/payroll SaaS, so user-configurable background automations are a fair question for it. The evidence shows no automation builder, scheduler, or agentic workflow. The closest items are a Xero option to auto-sync invoices the day after processing and holidays that are designated automatically each year. Both are fixed built-in behaviors, which count only as adjacent features, not automations a user sets up.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
